summary.intent: Migrate protobuf imports and call sites from github.com/golang/protobuf to google.golang.org/protobuf (caller-supplied PR #6919 text and the range's commit messages).
summary.issue_fit: Issue alignment unavailable: no issue was supplied or referenced; intent comes from the caller-supplied pull-request text and commit messages. The migration covers most call sites but narrows public paths to APIv2 messages, and several golang/protobuf usages remain (see question).
summary.coverage: All 68 changed files reviewed against the merge-base diff; build of all packages and focused tests of 17 changed packages pass at head; scratch overlay tests reproduced the three APIv1 regressions. The test/tools module could not be built or tidied offline. Uncommitted changes (an untracked `.mcp.json` in the clone) were not reviewed.
check_details: Reviewer-executed at head b8374114 (offline, GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly GOPROXY=off): `go build ./...` exit 0; `go -C examples build ./...` exit 0.

Reviewer-executed at head: `go test` on ./status ./internal/binarylog ./internal/transport ./balancer/rls ./encoding/proto ./internal/testutils ./xds/internal/clusterspecifier/rls ./xds/internal/xdsclient/xdsresource ./xds/internal/xdsclient ./xds/internal/httpfilter/fault ./xds/internal/xdsclient/transport ./xds/internal/xdsclient/xdsresource/tests ./xds/internal/xdsclient/xdslbregistry ./xds/internal/xdsclient/bootstrap ./xds/csds ./internal/xds/rbac ./orca: all ok.

Reviewer-executed scratch overlay tests (files under clone-work/overlay, clone unchanged): default codec rejects an APIv1-only message; Status.Details returns *impl.messageIfaceWrapper for a registered APIv1 detail; binarylog ServerMessage logs Length=0 for an APIv1 reply.
Unavailable: `go -C test/tools list -m all` fails offline (module lookup disabled by GOPROXY=off), so vet.sh's goimports/staticcheck install and `go mod tidy` check for test/tools were not run.
coverage_gaps: test/tools/go.mod and test/tools/go.sum: vet.sh's tools install and `go mod tidy` check could not run offline because the x/tools and honnef.co module sources are absent from the cache; running `./vet.sh -install` or `go mod tidy` in test/tools with network access would settle whether go.sum is tidy (affects test/tools/go.mod-downgrades-x-tools).

findings.title: Keep the default proto codec accepting APIv1-only messages
findings.trigger: Swapping the import to `google.golang.org/protobuf/proto` makes the unchanged `v.(proto.Message)` assertions in `Marshal` and `Unmarshal` require `ProtoReflect`, so any RPC using a message generated by protoc-gen-go before 1.4 or by gogo/protobuf hits the error branch.
findings.impact: Those RPCs now fail with `failed to marshal, message is %T, want proto.Message`, though the base codec encoded them; a scratch test reproduced this at head.
findings.change: In `encoding/proto/proto.go` lines 40-54, accept `protoadapt.MessageV1` values by converting them with `protoadapt.MessageV2Of` before `proto.Marshal`/`proto.Unmarshal`, erroring only for values implementing neither interface.

findings.title: Return the registered Go type from Status.Details for APIv1 messages
findings.trigger: `Details` now appends `any.UnmarshalNew()`'s APIv2 value directly, so a detail whose registered type is an APIv1-only message comes back as `*impl.messageIfaceWrapper`; the base's `ptypes.DynamicAny` path returned the user's type.
findings.impact: Callers' type switches on `status.FromError(err).Details()` stop matching those details, silently skipping error-detail handling.
findings.change: Append `protoadapt.MessageV1Of(detail)` instead of `detail`; it unwraps legacy messages and returns generated APIv2 messages unchanged.

findings.title: Keep binary-logging payloads of APIv1-only messages
findings.trigger: After the import swap, `ClientMessage.toProto` and `ServerMessage.toProto` assert the APIv2 `proto.Message`, so an APIv1-only unary reply that `server.go` passes as `Message: reply` (reachable with a codec that accepts it) matches neither branch.
findings.impact: The binary log records that message with `Length=0` and no data instead of the marshaled payload.
findings.change: In `internal/binarylog/method_logger.go` lines 242 and 282, also accept `protoadapt.MessageV1` values via `protoadapt.MessageV2Of` before `proto.Marshal`.

findings.title: Report the CheckValid error for an invalid LRS interval
findings.trigger: When the first LoadStatsResponse has a missing or invalid `load_reporting_interval`, the new code discards `CheckValid()`'s error and formats the outer `err` from `stream.Recv()`, which is always nil there.
findings.impact: The stream still fails, but the error reads `invalid load_reporting_interval: <nil>`, hiding the cause.
findings.change: Use `if err := rInterval.CheckValid(); err != nil {` so the returned error carries the validation failure.

findings.title: Restore golang.org/x/tools v0.17.0 in the tools module
findings.trigger: Merge commit b8374114 resolved `test/tools/go.mod` by keeping the branch's stale `golang.org/x/tools v0.14.0` (plus `golang.org/x/sys v0.13.0`), reverting the merge-base's #6939 bump to v0.17.0.
findings.impact: `vet.sh -install` then builds an older goimports than the base pinned, undoing that update with no stated intent; the migration only needed the protobuf swap.
findings.change: Keep `golang.org/x/tools v0.17.0` while replacing `github.com/golang/protobuf` with `google.golang.org/protobuf`, then regenerate `test/tools/go.sum` with `go mod tidy`.

questions.title: Are the remaining github.com/golang/protobuf usages intentionally left for follow-up?
questions.evidence: The supplied text says the change migrates imports and call sites across the repository, but at head `credentials/credentials.go:31`, `internal/pretty/pretty.go:27`, and `xds/internal/xdsclient/bootstrap/bootstrap.go:32` (jsonpb) still import golang/protobuf, and channelz/service was deliberately reverted (commit 58ad782d).
questions.why_it_matters: If this PR is meant to complete the migration, the omitted sites become a requirement finding; if they are deferred, the requirement row closes as scoped.
questions.answer: The PR author or a grpc-go maintainer can state whether these sites are in scope for this change.

observations.fact: Status.Details now reports undecodable details with google.golang.org/protobuf error text (for example `invalid empty type URL` instead of `message type url "" is invalid`), and the changed test expects the new text.

requirements.evidence: Most call sites migrated; credentials/credentials.go, internal/pretty/pretty.go, xds bootstrap.go jsonpb and channelz/service still use golang/protobuf (question migration/remaining-golang-protobuf-usages). Compatibility: violated for APIv1-only messages (findings encoding/proto/default-codec-rejects-apiv1-messages, internal/status/details-returns-wrappers-for-apiv1-messages, internal/binarylog/message-payload-dropped-for-apiv1-messages).
internal/status/status.go:134; protoadapt.MessageV1 and golang/protobuf proto.Message are both aliases of protoiface.MessageV1, so the public signature is unchanged.
No channelz/ file is in the merge-base diff.
The test was deleted again in c784e0a7 and is absent at head; it covered only APIv2 timestamps. The independent defect is internal/status/details-returns-wrappers-for-apiv1-messages.
